label: THE COMEBACK
voice_script: His career was over. After four back surgeries, even he thought he'd never play again. Eleven years without a major win. The world had written him off. But in 2019, Tiger Woods returned to the one place that defines legends: Augusta. And on that Sunday, he didn't just win. He rewrote history, closing a circle that had started twenty-two years earlier, in the exact same spot.

screens.text: The greatest comeback in sports history.
screens.clip_moment: Tiger roars and pumps his fist in celebration immediately after the final putt drops on the 18th green.

screens.clip_description: Tiger Woods 2017 Dubai Desert Classic press conference
screens.clip_moment: Tiger Woods sitting at a press conference table, looking somber or in pain.

screens.text: But on Sunday at the 2019 Masters...
screens.clip_moment: His tee shot on the 16th hole landing on the green and rolling down the slope to stop inches from the cup.
A wide shot of the massive crowd erupting as Tiger's final putt drops.

screens.text: This moment was for his family.
screens.clip_moment: Tiger walking off the 18th green and hugging his son Charlie in a long embrace.

screens.text: Just as this moment was for his.
screens.subtitle: 22 years earlier
screens.clip_moment: A young Tiger Woods, after his first Masters win, walks off the 18th green and gives his father Earl Woods a huge hug.
